title: Design: adding Service Parts and Part Sales in Edit Customer looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Create a customer for this test whose one Sales Representative is sales rep A.
  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Open the design pictures "customer-08-n2-service-parts.png" (board 2.8), "customer-09-n2-add-menu-2.png" (board 2.9), "customer-10-n2-three-added.png" (board 2.10) and "customer-11-n2-ps-list.png" (board 2.11) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open the customer's Edit Customer window in that browser window.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Add "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and compare with the picture of board 2.8.
  2. Click the + and compare the menu with the picture of board 2.9.
  3. Add "Sales Representative - Part Sales" and compare with the picture of board 2.10.
  4. Open the Part Sales list and compare with the picture of board 2.11.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The first field reads "Sales Representative - Service Labor".
  • "Sales Representative - Service Parts" shows under it.
  • Both read sales rep A.
  • A remove x shows beside Service Parts.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists only "Sales Representative - Part Sales".

Step 3:

  • Three fields show, in order: Service Labor, Service Parts, Part Sales.
  • Each added field has a remove x.
  • The + is gone.
  • The labels show in full.

Step 4:

  • The list is the same as every other field's: "Unassigned" first, then the representatives.
  • There is no "Same as Service Parts" option.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 13 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R7: “Adding Service Parts renames the first field "Sales Representative - Service Labor" and shows "Sales Representative - Service Parts" under it. Both start with the person who was in the first field, or "Unassigned". When that person's Sales Representative switch is off or their account is deactivated, the first field keeps them, as "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)" (S4-N2), and the added Service Parts field starts "Unassigned".”
  • S4-R8: “Adding Part Sales shows "Sales Representative - Part Sales" last. It starts with the person new part sales get at that moment (S4-R26), or "Unassigned". Under S4-R27 a person whose Sales Representative switch is off or whose account is deactivated is never copied: the added field then starts "Unassigned", and the field they hold keeps them (S4-N2).”
  • S4-R9: “The fields always show in this order: the first field ("Sales Representative", or "Sales Representative - Service Labor" once Service Parts is added), then Service Parts, then Part Sales.”
  • S4-R10: “Service Parts and Part Sales each have the remove x of S2-R8 to their right, with the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts" or "Remove Sales Representative - Part Sales". The first field has the + instead, while there is something left to add, and otherwise no button.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 2.8 Service Parts added; 2.9 The + menu now offers Part Sales only; 2.10 Part Sales added: three rows; 2.11 The Part Sales list (the attached pictures are these boards).

Design pictures attached to this case: customer-08-n2-service-parts.png, customer-09-n2-add-menu-2.png, customer-10-n2-three-added.png, customer-11-n2-ps-list.png.

  • Design — board 2.8 title: “2.8 Service Parts added”
  • Design — board 2.8 note: “The first field is renamed "Sales Representative - Service Labor". The new "Sales Representative - Service Parts" row starts with the same person (Christian Wallace), so adding it alone moves no credit, and its list does not open on its own. It has a remove x beside it.”
  • Design — board 2.9 title: “2.9 The + menu now offers Part Sales only”
  • Design — board 2.9 note: “Service Parts is already added, so the menu lists only "Sales Representative - Part Sales".”
  • Design — board 2.10 title: “2.10 Part Sales added: three rows”
  • Design — board 2.10 note: “Service Labor, Service Parts and Part Sales; Service Parts and Part Sales each have a remove x. The + is gone: nothing left to add. Part Sales also starts with the person already credited.”
  • Design — board 2.11 title: “2.11 The Part Sales list”
  • Design — board 2.11 note: “Jason Garrison is picked for Service Parts. The Part Sales list is the same as every other: Unassigned first, then the reps. No "Same as Service Parts" option.”
